text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 浅灰粗针织一字肩宽翻领长袖毛衣，黑色短裤，灰色过膝罗纹长袜，深灰大翻口麂皮中筒靴。。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue product photo. Pure white seamless background, neutral soft studio lighting, realistic fabric texture. Portrait 2:3, full objects uncropped with comfortable margins. NO people, skin, body parts, face, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, stand, scene, text, brand logos or watermark. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation; see white background through sheer fabrics. Preserve the reference garment colors, silhouette, construction and fabric. Do not invent footwear when not visible. Reconstruct obscured seams conservatively. Reference image is design input only. Target ONLY image 4 position r1c2. rNcM means row N, column M, counted left to right, top to bottom across the full image. Images 2 through 8 each have two rows and four columns. Target ONLY the largest central person inside the selected cell; ignore all small background thumbnails. Image 1 is one street-style outfit. All shoes must be EMPTY without feet or toes. All open garment gaps show pure white with no anatomy. Ignore all other outfits, text and objects. GARMENTS AND SHOWN FOOTWEAR ONLY: 浅灰粗针织一字肩宽翻领长袖毛衣，黑色短裤，灰色过膝罗纹长袜，深灰大翻口麂皮中筒靴。. Remove ALL detachable accessories including 炭灰针织围巾披在臂侧. Keep integral garment fasteners, sewn bows and ties. No new items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
